newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * The lower Chamber of Deputies is negotiating the chairmanship and composition of the standing commissions.
* President Emil Constantinescu is to meet representatives of Romania's ethnic minorities represented in parliament later on Wednesday.
* The second NATO summit will be held in Brussels starting December 10, said foreign ministry spokesman Sorin Ducaru.
* The trade union federation of Romania's truck drivers is holding its third congress to elect a new leadership and establish a new programme. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
